instructions.primary_message: Place a medium bowl (preferably metal) in the freezer to chill. (If space is limited, place in the refrigerator.)
Wash, dry, and zest the oranges into a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ oranges

instructions.primary_message: Juice the oranges into a medium saucepan. Add cherries and sugar to the pan, stir to combine, and set aside to thaw.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cup frozen cherries
⅓ cup granulated sugar

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a box grater, coarsely grate cream cheese into the bowl with the orange zest; add vanilla and cardamom. Use a silicone spatula or fork to soften and combine the cream cheese mixture, creating a smooth cream.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (227 g) block cream cheese
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract
3 pinch cardamom, ground

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer, sift powdered sugar into the bowl with the cream cheese. Use the spatula or fork to mash and combine the mixture until smooth and no lumps remain. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup powdered sugar

instructions.primary_message: Remove bowl from the freezer. Pour cold cream into the bowl; use a whisk (or hand blender) to beat the cream vigorously, until medium-soft peaks form, about 4 minutes if whisking. (When you pull the whisk out of the bowl, the cream should hold its shape, with a peak that curls over slightly.)
instructions.secondary_message: 355 ml heavy cream

instructions.primary_message: Transfer half of the whipped cream to the bowl with the cream cheese mixture. Using a silicone spatula, gently fold the two together until almost combined. Add remaining whipped cream and continue to fold until just combined.
Divide the mousse between small bowls, cups, or jars. Cover with plastic wrap or lids and refrigerate until set, about 1 hour (or overnight).
While the mousse sets, make the cherry compote. Place the saucepan with the cherry mixture over medium heat and bring to a simmer.
In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup water
2 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: When the liquid in the saucepan is simmering, add slurry in a steady stream while stirring quickly with a silicone spatula. Simmer until sauce thickens, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Transfer cherry compote to a medium, heat-proof bowl or container and let cool to room temperature. Cover with plastic wrap or a lid and refrigerate until ready to use.
To serve, top mousse with cherry compote and enjoy!
Place cherries in a colander and run under cold water to thaw; set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cup frozen cherries

instructions.primary_message: Place milk, chocolate, sugar, and vanilla in a medium saucepan. Slowly melt chocolate over low heat, stirring constantly, until sauce is combined and thickened, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
177 ml whole milk
1 cup dark chocolate chips
1 ½ tbsp granulated sugar
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop cherries.
Peel bananas and halve lengthwise.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 bananas

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide bananas and ice cream between bowls. Top with chocolate sauce and cherries. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1065 ml vanilla ice cream

instructions.primary_message: Line the bottom of a large baking dish with parchment paper and set aside.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, small dice apricots and transfer to a small bowl along with cranberries. Toss to combine the dried fruit mix and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 dried apricots
⅓ cup dried cranberries

instructions.primary_message: Uncover the pan and place a medium, heat-proof, bowl over the simmering water, allowing it to sit on the rim. Add chocolate and oil to the bowl; using a silicone spatula, stir continuously, until melted.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup dark chocolate chips
1 ½ tsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Remove bowl from the heat, add vanilla and salt; stir until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp vanilla extract
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add half the dried fruit mix to the bowl and stir to incorporate. (Set remaining dried fruit mix aside.)
Pour chocolate mixture into the baking dish. Using a silicone spatula, spread out to a thickness of between ¼ and ½-inch.

Sprinkle remaining dried fruit mix over the chocolate, pressing gently into the surface to adhere. Place baking dish in the freezer (or refrigerator if space is limited) and chill until firm, about 10 minutes.
Remove bark from the freezer, transfer to a cutting board, and chop into large pieces. Store in the freezer (or refrigerator) until ready to serve.
To serve, divide chocolate bark between plates and enjoy!
Place yogurt, maple syrup, cinnamon, and vanilla in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dip and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp cinnamon
¾ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, quarter, and core pears; slice each quarter into wedges.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 pears

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pears and dip between plates. Sprinkle cinnamon over the dip and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 pinch cinnamon

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 230°C (450°F) and position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Transfer naan to a large baking sheet pan. Place on the upper rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until slightly crispy, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 flatbreads or naan

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry apples. Peel, quarter, core, and small dice; transfer to another large baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 Gala apples

instructions.primary_message: Using a box grater, coarsely grate cold butter. Sprinkle butter, sugar, and cinnamon over the apples.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
3 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp cinnamon

instructions.primary_message: Place apples on the lower rack of the oven and bake until fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, melt additional butter in a medium saucepan over low heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Once butter is melted, whisk in cream, sugar, honey, and salt. Increase heat to medium and simmer, whisking frequently, until glaze is slightly thickened and glossy, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, and let cool slightly to further thicken the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
89 ml (⅜ cup) heavy cream
⅓ cup brown sugar
3 tbsp honey
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: To assemble, spoon baked apples over the surface of each crispy naan. Drizzle with brown sugar glaze.
Cut naan into pieces.
To serve, divide naan pieces between plates and enjoy!
Wash, dry, zest, and juice oranges into a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ oranges

instructions.primary_message: Add ricotta, honey, and vanilla to the bowl with the orange. Whisk until light, fluffy, and combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (425 g) pkgs ricotta cheese
3 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 mangoes

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide whipped ricotta between bowls and top with mango. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium carrots
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ limes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and slice carrots into ¼-inch thick rounds. Place in a large bowl along with maple syrup, oil, and salt; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Transfer carrots to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

While the carrots are roasting, divide flatbreads between two additional baking sheets. Add to the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 flatbreads or naan

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl along with yogurt and salt; stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups plain Greek yogurt
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. Transfer to the reserved bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl with the garlic; add oil, maple syrup, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice apricots and add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 18 dried apricots

instructions.primary_message: Once the carrots have cooled to room temperature, transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide minted yogurt between flatbreads and spread out in an even layer. Top each flatbread with carrot-arugula salad and slice into wedges.
To serve, divide flatbreads between plates and drizzle with vinegar. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ small bunches asparagus
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a large bowl.
Add eggs, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the dill; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
15 eggs
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (113 g) pkg smoked salmon

instructions.primary_message: Crumble goat cheese into the bowl; stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (113 g) logs goat cheese

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Slice crosswise into ½-inch pieces and place in another large bowl.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add asparagus, green onions, salt, and pepper to the skillet; cook, stirring often, until asparagus is crisp-tender, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Pour the egg mixture into the skillet with the veggies; gently stir to combine. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 7-8 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set, about 3 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the frittata is cooking, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp honey
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve tomatoes. Trim and medium dice cucumbers; add both to the bowl with the dressing. Add mixed greens and toss to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper and set aside.
Place coconut in a large skillet set over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until coconut is lightly toasted, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 cups shredded unsweetened coconut

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, small dice dates; add to the bowl with the toasted coconut.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup medjool dates, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Uncover the saucepan and place a medium heat-proof bowl over the simmering water, allowing it to sit on the rim. Add chocolate and oil to the bowl; using a silicone spatula, stir continuously, until melted.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup dark chocolate chips
1 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Remove bowl from the heat. Add vanilla and salt; stir until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp vanilla extract
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut and dates to the bowl with the chocolate; stir to incorporate.

Using a tablespoon measure, place heaping mounds of the chocolate mixture on the baking sheet. Place baking sheet in the freezer (or refrigerator if space is limited) and chill until firm, 5-10 minutes. Store in the freezer (or refrigerator) until ready to serve.
To serve, remove haystacks from the parchment paper and divide between plates. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a medium bowl. (Set lemons aside for later use.)
Drain salmon and place in the bowl with the lemon zest; flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (213 g) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomatoes and add to the bowl along with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp basil, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Crumble goat cheese into the bowl, stir to combine the salmon salad, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (113 g) logs goat cheese

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl.
Roughly chop olives, sun-dried tomatoes, and capers; add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
9 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
3 tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl along with the oil. Stir to combine the tapenade dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve the cucumbers lengthwise; slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Toast bread if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices whole grain bread

instructions.primary_message: Place bread slices on a flat surface. Divide salmon salad between half of the slices; cover with remaining slices.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Wash, dry, and quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 peaches

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, sugar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
¾ cup brown sugar
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
3 pinch nutmeg, ground
3 pinch clove, ground

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sweetened yogurt, peaches, and pumpkin seeds between jars or bowls, alternating ingredients to create layers. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ small bunches asparagus
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Transfer tomatoes to a large baking sheet pan and arrange in a single layer. Cut butter into small pieces and dot over the tomatoes. Drizzle with vinegar and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup butter, unsalted
1 ½ tsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until tomatoes begin to burst, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, about 6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp salt
425 g linguine pasta

instructions.primary_message: While the pasta is cooking, snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Cut into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 170 g Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add asparagus to the pot with the pasta and continue to cook until pasta reaches desired firmness and asparagus is tender, about 3 minutes. Drain pasta and asparagus in a colander, reserving 1 cup of pasta cooking water. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Return the pot to low heat. Add roasted tomatoes, drained pasta, and asparagus; cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes coat the pasta, 4-5 minutes.
Add Parmesan to the pot and stir until melted.
Add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sweet potatoes
1 small pkg chives
1 ½ limes
3 Granny Smith apples
3 (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel and cut sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes; transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to combine; spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potatoes are golden brown and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, mince chives and place in a small bowl.
Juice limes into the bowl with the chives.
Add yogurt, mayo, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing. If necessary, add water, 1 tablespoon at a time, to reach a drizzling consistency; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp parsley flakes
¾ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice mozzarella and transfer to a large plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces; add to the plate with the mozzarella.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (113 g) pkg smoked salmon

instructions.primary_message: Quarter and core apples, then medium dice and add to the plate.
To serve, divide arugula between plates or bowls; top with sweet potato, mozzarella, salmon, and apple. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplants
3 medium zucchini squash
3 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice eggplants and zucchini; place both in a large bowl.
Peel and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with onion and garlic.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and celery; cook, stirring often, until softened, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add eggplant, zucchini, and spices to the pot; reduce heat to medium and cover. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pat the lamb chops dry with paper towels and place on a large plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 lamb loin chops
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are ready, add tomatoes, capers, vinegar, and sugar to the pot; stir to combine the caponata. Bring to a simmer and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 10-12 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
3 tbsp capers
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: While the caponata is cooking, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add lamb chops and cook, flipping once, until cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a clean plate, cover with aluminum foil, and let rest 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Stir parsley into the caponata (reserving a small handful for serving).
To serve, divide caponata and lamb chops between plates; top caponata with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch cilantro
3 jalapeño peppers
3 red bell peppers
6 peaches

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a large bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime along with oil, sugar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice jalapeños into rounds and add to the bowl; stir to combine and set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, bone-in
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer chops to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: While the chops are cooking, trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in another large bowl.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice and add to the bowl with the bell pepper.

Return the pot (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper and peaches; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and lightly charred in spots, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: When the bell pepper and peaches are done, transfer to the bowl with the dressing; stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chops and peach salad between plates. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ bunches radish
3 avocados
1 ½ limes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate; season with spices on the top-side.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add salmon and cook until opaque and easily flakes with a fork, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Halve avocados and remove pits; scoop out the flesh into the bowl with the garlic.
Juice limes into the bowl, add salt, and mash the guacamole with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop pumpkin seeds, add to the bowl with the guacamole, and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: Right before serving, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and radish; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salmon and salad between plates; top salmon with guacamole and enjoy!
This recipe will make about 9 cups of smoothie. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 bananas
1 ½ limes
1 ½ (170 g) pkg blackberries

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice bananas; set aside.
Zest and juice limes into a blender.
Add frozen mixed berries, yogurt, milk, honey, and cinnamon to the blender.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cup frozen mixed berries
3 cups plain Greek yogurt
355 ml whole milk
⅓ cup honey
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Blend on high speed until smooth, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide smoothie between bowls and top with banana, blackberries, and granola. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 cup granola, nut free

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). Line two baking sheet pans with parchment paper and set aside.
Peel bananas, break into chunks, and place in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ bananas

instructions.primary_message: Add sugar, oil, and vanilla to the bowl with the banana. Crush with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup brown sugar
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Add granola to the bowl, breaking apart any extra-large pieces with your hands, and stir to combine; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 cup granola, vegan

instructions.primary_message: Place flour, cornstarch, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup all-purpose flour
¾ tsp cornstarch
½ tsp baking powder
½ tsp baking soda
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Add flour mixture to the bowl with the banana and stir to combine the cookie batter.
Using a scant ¼-cup measure, divide batter into 12 portions and place on the baking sheets. Using a silicone spatula or the back of a spoon, spread each cookie into a 2-inch circle.
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until cookies are golden and slightly firm around the edges, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature.

Once cool, arrange half of the cookies on a flat surface, bottom-side facing up. Place a scoop of ice cream on top of each, then cover with remaining cookies. Gently press cookies into the ice cream to secure the sandwiches.
instructions.secondary_message: 532 ml vanilla ice cream, vegan

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide ice cream sandwiches between plates and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium parsnips
6 medium carrots
3 small bunches asparagus
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim, peel, and medium dice parsnips and carrots; place both in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until veggies are soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp honey
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus, then cut spears into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sea scallops
¾ tsp salt

133 ml whole milk
3 eggs

¾ tsp vanilla extract

3 (142 g) pkg baby spinach

1 ½ tsp poppy seeds
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.secondary_message:
3 fennel bulbs
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage

2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

36 dried apricots
⅓ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.

1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless

¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the apricots along with additional oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the dressing.

3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup white wine vinegar
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

To serve, divide cabbage salad, fennel, and chicken between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 fennel bulbs
0.68 kg red grapes
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp rosemary, dried
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a large bowl along with additional oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the pumpkin seeds.
instructions.secondary_message:
85 g Parmesan cheese
⅓ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: Transfer cooled fennel and grapes to the bowl, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad.

To serve, divide steak and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless

6 cloves garlic
9 anchovy fillets, packed in oil

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.

¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
3 tbsp capers
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add olive mixture and cook, stirring frequently, until garlic is fragrant, 1-2 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes and salt to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until simmering, 1-2 minutes. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat.

3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.

3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 85 g Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ bunches kale

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the puttanesca sauce and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving).

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Top chicken with puttanesca sauce and reserved parsley. Enjoy!

1 ½ cups basmati rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

6 medium carrots
3 red bell peppers
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.

3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1.02 kg ground turkey
1 tbsp curry powder
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 tbsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium carrots
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ bunches kale

3 medium red onions

¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Crumble goat cheese onto the plate with the dates.

1.7 kg chicken drumsticks

1 ½ lemons
9 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a clean large bowl.

9 medium zucchini squash

3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce

instructions.primary_message: Halve apricots lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices, add to the bowl, and toss to combine. Set aside.

Pat halloumi dry with paper towels; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the halloumi in half horizontally, then cut each half lengthwise into 1-inch thick strips. Season both sides with the reserved spice mix.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (250 g) pkgs halloumi cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary, add the halloumi and cook, turning halfway through, until golden brown on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve skillet for later use and bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, and spices in another large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp cumin, ground
¼ tsp coriander, ground
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with the arugula, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.

Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Add apricots and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and caramelized, 3-4 minutes. Return halloumi to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide salad and halloumi sauté between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ small pineapples
3 green bell peppers
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a large bowl along with water, soy sauce, honey, oil, cornstarch, and spices. Whisk to combine the teriyaki marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup water
⅓ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the marinade.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then medium dice. Add to the bowl and stir to combine. Divide pineapple, veggies, and chicken between two large baking sheet pans, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a clean large bowl.
When the chicken and veggies have about 10 minutes left, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower rice, water, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is golden and tender, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
⅓ cup water
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cauliflower rice and teriyaki chicken bake between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small butternut squash
3 leeks
1 ½ oranges
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Trim and peel each squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit, then slice crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the baking sheets with the squash.

Zest oranges over the veggies, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until squash is golden and fork-tender, 25-30 minutes. (Reserve oranges for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger. Place in a large bowl, along with spices, then stir to combine the spice rub.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground
⅛ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat halloumi dry with paper towels; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the halloumi in half horizontally, then cut each half lengthwise into 1-inch thick strips. Add to the bowl with the spice rub and turn to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (250 g) pkgs halloumi cheese

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add the halloumi and cook, turning halfway through, until golden brown on both sides, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice reserved oranges into the bowl with the garlic, then add tahini, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the glaze and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tahini
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the halloumi is done, transfer to the bowl with the glaze and gently toss to coat.
To serve, divide squash, leeks, and glazed halloumi between plates or bowls. Drizzle with any leftover glaze in the bowl. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F). Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and spices, then toss to coat. Divide between the baking sheets, spread out in an even layer, and drizzle with additional oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed
2 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crowns broccoli
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ bunches radish

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add broccoli and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli is tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the broccoli is cooking, roughly chop dates.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup medjool dates, pitted

instructions.primary_message: When the broccoli is done, add dates and sesame seeds to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until dates have softened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into a clean large bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl, along with feta and cooked broccoli, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

instructions.primary_message: This recipe will make about 9 cups of smoothie. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Place tahini, maple syrup, cinnamon, and salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup tahini
3 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel bananas, break into chunks, and place in a blender.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 bananas

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry blueberries. Add to the blender along with milk, yogurt, and 12 ice cubes, then blend on high speed until smooth, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (170 g) pkgs blueberries
710 ml whole milk
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide smoothie between bowls. Top with granola and drizzle with maple tahini. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cup granola, nut free

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch fresh dill
3 (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 shallot

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop dates. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens and feta, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup medjool dates, pitted
1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak into strips.
To serve, divide salad and steak between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Wash, dry, and cut off skin and white pith from the grapefruits; slice between membranes to release segments. Place segments in a medium bowl, along with spices, and stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 grapefruits
3 pinch salt
3 pinch cinnamon, ground
3 pinch cloves, ground

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut; cook, stirring often, until lightly toasted and fragrant, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup shredded unsweetened coconut

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide yogurt and spiced grapefruit between bowls. Top with toasted coconut, then drizzle with maple syrup. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add coconut milk, water, sugar, vanilla, salt, and cinnamon. Set over medium heat and bring to a simmer, stirring frequently.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
1 ½ (398 ml) cans coconut milk
266 ml water
⅓ cup brown sugar
1 tbsp vanilla extract
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a simmer, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice, undisturbed, until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pineapples
1 ½ lemons
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Place in a large pot.
Zest and juice lemons into the pot with the pineapple.
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the pot, along with sugar and water, then stir to combine. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until pineapple is soft and juicy, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup brown sugar
44 ml water

instructions.primary_message: Once the pineapple is soft, crush with a fork or potato masher; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until compote thickens, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
When the rice is done, remove from heat. Add milk to the pan, stir to combine, and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 355 ml whole milk

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice pudding between bowls, then top with pineapple compote. Enjoy!
Place water, maple syrup, and salt in a large pot, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1242 ml water
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once boiling, stir in oats. Cover and let simmer, on low, 3-5 minutes, or until oats reach desired consistency. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cup oats, quick cooking

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry raspberries. Place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (170 g) pkgs raspberries

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop apricots. Add to the bowl with the raspberries, stir to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 24 dried apricots

instructions.primary_message: Place additional maple syrup and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup pure maple syrup
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp cardamom, ground
3 pinch cloves, ground

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide oatmeal between bowls, top with fruit, then drizzle with spiced maple syrup. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ green bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to a large bowl.
Peel and finely dice the onion. Peel and mince garlic; add both to the bowl with the parsley.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium red onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add ground beef, eggs, and spices to the bowl and mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
3 eggs
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat a large baking sheet pan with olive oil. Using a tablespoon measure, form the meat mixture into rounded meatballs and place in the dish, spacing them 1-inch apart. Place the dish in the oven and bake until cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, make the tzatziki. Mince half of the cucumber and transfer to a medium bowl along with the yogurt, oil, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Juice and grate the zest from the lemon into the tzatziki bowl.
Shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the tzatziki and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Halve the remaining cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds. Halve the tomatoes. Transfer both to a medium salad bowl.
Seed the peppers and slice crosswise to form rings. Peel and slice the remaining shallot into rings. Add both to the salad bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ shallots

instructions.primary_message: Add veggies, feta, olives, oil, and oregano to a salad bowl and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
⅜ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano, dried

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between bowls and top with meatballs and Tzatziki sauce. Enjoy!
